empty.claudeCode: No Claude Code logs found. Start a Claude Code session and logs will appear in ~/.claude/projects/
empty.codex: No Codex session logs found. Start a Codex session and logs will appear in ~/.codex/sessions/
empty.gemini: No Gemini session logs found. Start a Gemini session and logs will appear in ~/.gemini/sessions/
empty.cursor: No Cursor usage data found. Start using Cursor and data will appear automatically.
empty.windsurf: No Windsurf usage data found. Start using Windsurf and data will appear automatically.
empty.all: No usage data found from any tool. Start using Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini to see stats here.
empty.autoRefresh: Data will auto-refresh when new sessions are detected.

settings.title: Settings
settings.help_claude_step1: Open claude.ai in your browser and log in.
settings.help_claude_step3: Copy "sessionKey" → paste in Session Key. Copy "lastActiveOrg" → paste in Org ID.
settings.help_cursor_step1: Open Cursor IDE, then open DevTools (Help → Toggle Developer Tools).
settings.help_cursor_step3: Copy the value of "WorkosCursorSessionToken" and paste it in the Session Key field.
settings.help_windsurf_step1: Open Windsurf IDE, then open DevTools (Help → Toggle Developer Tools).
settings.help_windsurf_step3: Copy the session cookie value and paste it in the Session Key field.
